answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new agent must grow a trellis of distinct partners, each link built by work, not a whisper of self-dealing. The velvet rope lifts after twelve counterparties trade with it over twenty epochs, receipts verified on chain. Forging 100 identities means paying 100 times: each fake needs twelve trades at 5 POA of fees and escrow, so 100 clones cost 6,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
